content:
Use the uploaded image as the opening frame. Create a 15-second photorealistic fighting game parody scene in a suburban fast-food parking lot. Add a fighting game HUD with green health bars, character portraits, names, timer 60, ROUND 1, and EX bars.

Wendy stands on the left in a blue and white striped dress, white apron, red pigtails, striped stockings, and black boots. Ronald stands on the right in a red yellow white clown costume, red afro wig, white face paint, red nose, giant red shoes, and yellow gloves.

Bright afternoon sunlight, wet asphalt reflecting the sky, fast-food restaurants in the background, cinematic SF6 / Mortal Kombat style.

Start with the announcer saying “ROUND ONE — FIGHT!” Ronald charges forward at full speed. Wendy pulls out a giant chocolate milkshake and pours it onto the asphalt. Ronald slips on the shake in slow motion, arms flailing, shoes sliding across the glossy ground. Camera orbits him dramatically.

Wendy winds up and lands a spinning back kick while Ronald is slipping. Slow motion impact, speed ramp, Ronald launches backward across the parking lot and crashes onto the asphalt.

Ronald springs upright, pulls out a giant burger, eats it rapidly, then unleashes an exaggerated gross burp attack with a visible yellow-green wave and food chunks. Camera switches to Ronald POV as the stream flies across the parking lot and hits Wendy, launching her backward.

Final shot: Wendy sits on the ground defeated and disgusted while Ronald stands in the distance laughing triumphantly. Add announcer voice: “RONALD WINS.” Gold text on screen: RONALD WINS. Freeze frame, then cut to black.

---
Usa la imagen cargada como el cuadro de apertura. Crea una escena de parodia de juego de lucha fotorrealista de 15 segundos en un estacionamiento suburbano de comida rápida. Añade un HUD de juego de lucha con barras de salud verdes, retratos de personajes, nombres, temporizador 60, ROUND 1 y barras EX.

Wendy está a la izquierda con un vestido a rayas azules y blancas, delantal blanco, trenzas rojas, medias a rayas y botas negras. Ronald está a la derecha con un disfraz de payaso rojo, amarillo y blanco, peluca afro roja, maquillaje facial blanco, nariz roja, zapatos rojos gigantes y guantes amarillos.

Luz brillante de la tarde, asfalto mojado reflejando el cielo, restaurantes de comida rápida al fondo, estilo cinematográfico SF6 / Mortal Kombat.

Comienza con el anunciador diciendo “ROUND ONE — FIGHT!” Ronald avanza a toda velocidad. Wendy saca un batido de chocolate gigante y lo vierte sobre el asfalto. Ronald resbala en el batido en cámara lenta, agitando los brazos, los zapatos deslizándose por el suelo brillante. La cámara lo orbita dramáticamente.

Wendy se prepara y lanza una patada giratoria mientras Ronald resbala. Impacto en cámara lenta, aceleración de velocidad, Ronald es lanzado hacia atrás a través del estacionamiento y se estrella contra el asfalto.

Ronald se levanta de un salto, saca una hamburguesa gigante, la come rápidamente y luego desata un ataque de eructo exagerado y asqueroso con una ola visible amarillo-verde y trozos de comida. La cámara cambia a la perspectiva de Ronald mientras el chorro vuela a través del estacionamiento y golpea a Wendy, lanzándola hacia atrás.

Toma final: Wendy se sienta en el suelo derrotada y disgustada mientras Ronald se ríe triunfante a lo lejos. Añadir voz del anunciador: “RONALD WINS.” Texto dorado en pantalla: RONALD WINS. Congelar imagen, luego cortar a negro.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] Intentamos hacer otro video al estilo de juego de lucha de comida rápida con Seedance 2.0, esta vez: Wendy vs Ronald McDonald.

La idea era que se sintiera como una parodia ridícula al estilo Street Fighter / Mortal Kombat, ambientada en un estacionamiento suburbano entre un Wendy’s y un McDonald’s. HUD completo, barras de salud, temporizador, barras EX, movimiento dramático de cámara, golpes en cámara lenta y momentos finales exagerados.

La secuencia comienza con Ronald cargando, pero Wendy contraataca vertiendo un batido de chocolate gigante sobre el asfalto. Ronald resbala en cámara lenta, es lanzado por una patada giratoria, y luego de alguna manera regresa con el ataque más maldito impulsado por hamburguesas posible.

Quería que todo se sintiera como una caótica pelea de jefe de arcade falsa: órbitas cinematográficas de cámara, aceleraciones de velocidad, asfalto mojado brillante, restaurantes de comida rápida al fondo y violencia de dibujos animados exagerada mezclada con energía de juego de lucha fotorrealista.

Hecho con Seedance 2.0 usando un cuadro de apertura y un prompt detallado toma por toma.

Seedance 2.0 prompt:
"Use the uploaded image as the opening frame. Create a 15-second photorealistic fighting game parody scene in a suburban fast-food parking lot. Add a fighting game HUD with green health bars, character portraits, names, timer 60, ROUND 1, and EX bars.

Wendy stands on the left in a blue and white striped dress, white apron, red pigtails, striped stockings, and black boots. Ronald stands on the right in a red yellow white clown costume, red afro wig, white face paint, red nose, giant red shoes, and yellow gloves.

Bright afternoon sunlight, wet asphalt reflecting the sky, fast-food restaurants in the background, cinematic SF6 / Mortal Kombat style.

Start with the announcer saying “ROUND ONE — FIGHT!” Ronald charges forward at full speed. Wendy pulls out a giant chocolate milkshake and pours it onto the asphalt. Ronald slips on the shake in slow motion, arms flailing, shoes sliding across the glossy ground. Camera orbits him dramatically.

Wendy winds up and lands a spinning back kick while Ronald is slipping. Slow motion impact, speed ramp, Ronald launches backward across the parking lot and crashes onto the asphalt.

Ronald springs upright, pulls out a giant burger, eats it rapidly, then unleashes an exaggerated gross burp attack with a visible yellow-green wave and food chunks. Camera switches to Ronald POV as the stream flies across the parking lot and hits Wendy, launching her backward.

Final shot: Wendy sits on the ground defeated and disgusted while Ronald stands in the distance laughing triumphantly. Add announcer voice: “RONALD WINS.” Gold text on screen: RONALD WINS. Freeze frame, then cut to black."

Este se volvió mucho más caótico de lo esperado, pero Seedance manejó sorprendentemente bien el movimiento de cámara y el ritmo del juego de lucha.

Wendy se tient à gauche dans une robe à rayures bleues et blanches, un tablier blanc, des tresses rouges, des bas rayés et des bottes noires. Commencez avec l'annonceur disant « ROUND ONE — FIGHT ! » Ronald charge à pleine vitesse. Wendy sort un énorme milkshake au chocolat et le verse sur l'asphalte. ja.content:
---
アップロードされた画像をオープニングフレームとして使用してください。郊外のファストフード駐車場で、15秒のフォトリアリスティックな格闘ゲームのパロディシーンを作成します。緑の体力バー、キャラクターポートレート、名前、タイマー60、ROUND 1、EXバーを備えた格闘ゲームのHUDを追加します。

ウェンディは左側に立ち、青と白のストライプのドレス、白いエプロン、赤いおさげ髪、ストライプのストッキング、黒いブーツを着用しています。ロナルドは右側に立ち、赤、黄色、白のピエロの衣装、赤いアフロウィッグ、白いフェイスペイント、赤い鼻、巨大な赤い靴、黄色の手袋を着用しています。

明るい午後の日差し、空を反射する濡れたアスファルト、背景にファストフードレストラン、シネマティックなSF6 / Mortal Kombatスタイル。

アナウンサーが「ROUND ONE — FIGHT!」と言うところから始めます。ロナルドは全速力で前進します。ウェンディは巨大なチョコレートミルクシェイクを取り出し、アスファルトに注ぎます。ロナルドはスローモーションでシェイクに滑り、腕を振り回し、靴が光沢のある地面を滑ります。カメラが彼を劇的に回ります。

ウェンディは巻き上げて、ロナルドが滑っている間にスピニングバックキックを決めます。スローモーションの衝撃、スピードランプ、ロナルドは駐車場を横切って後方に打ち上げられ、アスファルトに激突します。

ロナルドはすぐに立ち上がり、巨大なバーガーを取り出して急いで食べ、目に見える黄緑色の波と食べ物の塊を伴う誇張されたグロスバープ攻撃を解き放ちます。カメラはロナルドの視点に切り替わり、ストリームが駐車場を横切ってウェンディに当たり、彼女を後方に打ち上げます。

最後のショット：ウェンディは地面に座り、敗北し嫌悪感を抱いている一方で、ロナルドは遠くで勝ち誇って笑っています。アナウンサーの声を追加：「RONALD WINS」。画面に金色のテキスト：RONALD WINS。フリーズフレーム、そしてブラックアウト。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[スレッド1] Seedance 2.0を使って別のファストフード格闘ゲームスタイルのビデオを作ろうとしました。今回は：ウェンディ対ロナルド・マクドナルド。

このアイデアは、ウェンディーズとマクドナルドの間の郊外の駐車場を舞台にした、ばかげたストリートファイター / モータルコンバットスタイルのパロディに感じさせることでした。フルHUD、体力バー、タイマー、EXバー、劇的なカメラの動き、スローモーションのヒット、そしてオーバーザトップなフィニッシングモーメント。

シーケンスはロナルドが突進するところから始まり、ウェンディが巨大なチョコレートミルクシェイクをアスファルトに注ぐことでカウンターします。ロナルドはスローモーションで滑り、スピニングバックキックで打ち上げられ、そしてどういうわけか最も呪われたバーガーパワーの攻撃で戻ってきます。

全体を混沌とした偽のアーケードボス戦のように感じさせたかったのです：シネマティックなカメラの回転、スピードランプ、光沢のある濡れたアスファルト、背景にファストフードレストラン、そしてフォトリアリスティックな格闘ゲームのエネルギーと混ざった誇張されたカートゥーンバイオレンス。

아나운서가 “ROUND ONE — FIGHT!”라고 외치며 시작합니다. 로널드는 전속력으로 앞으로 돌진합니다. 웬디는 거대한 초콜릿 밀크셰이크를 꺼내 아스팔트에 붓습니다. 로널드는 슬로우 모션으로 셰이크에 미끄러지며 팔을 휘두르고, 신발은 반짝이는 바닥을 가로질러 미끄러집니다. 카메라는 그를 극적으로 회전합니다.

웬디는 몸을 돌려 로널드가 미끄러지는 동안 회전 백킥을 날립니다. 슬로우 모션 충격, 속도 변화, 로널드는 주차장을 가로질러 뒤로 날아가 아스팔트에 충돌합니다.

마지막 장면: 웬디는 패배하고 역겨운 표정으로 땅에 앉아 있고, 로널드는 멀리서 승리의 웃음을 짓고 있습니다. 아나운서 목소리를 추가하세요: “RONALD WINS.” 화면에 금색 글씨로: RONALD WINS. 프리즈 프레임, 그리고 검은 화면으로 전환.

이 아이디어는 교외 주차장에서 웬디스와 맥도날드 사이에 설정된 우스꽝스러운 스트리트 파이터 / Mortal Kombat 스타일의 패러디처럼 느껴지도록 하는 것이었습니다. 전체 HUD, 체력 바, 타이머, EX 바, 극적인 카메라 움직임, 슬로우 모션 타격, 과장된 피니시 장면.

---
Use a imagem carregada como o quadro de abertura. Crie uma cena de paródia de jogo de luta fotorrealista de 15 segundos em um estacionamento de fast-food suburbano. Adicione um HUD de jogo de luta com barras de saúde verdes, retratos dos personagens, nomes, cronômetro 60, ROUND 1 e barras EX.

Wendy está à esquerda em um vestido listrado azul e branco, avental branco, tranças vermelhas, meias listradas e botas pretas. Ronald está à direita em uma fantasia de palhaço vermelha, amarela e branca, peruca afro vermelha, maquiagem branca no rosto, nariz vermelho, sapatos gigantes vermelhos e luvas amarelas.

Luz do sol brilhante da tarde, asfalto molhado refletindo o céu, restaurantes de fast-food ao fundo, estilo cinematográfico SF6 / Mortal Kombat.

Comece com o locutor dizendo "ROUND ONE — FIGHT!" Ronald avança a toda velocidade. Wendy pega um milkshake de chocolate gigante e derrama no asfalto. Ronald escorrega no milkshake em câmera lenta, braços agitando, sapatos deslizando pelo chão brilhante. A câmera orbita dramaticamente ao redor dele.

Wendy se prepara e acerta um chute giratório enquanto Ronald está escorregando. Impacto em câmera lenta, aceleração, Ronald é lançado para trás pelo estacionamento e cai no asfalto.

Ronald se levanta rapidamente, pega um hambúrguer gigante, come rapidamente e então libera um ataque de arroto exagerado e nojento com uma onda visível amarelo-esverdeada e pedaços de comida. A câmera muda para a visão de Ronald enquanto o fluxo voa pelo estacionamento e atinge Wendy, lançando-a para trás.

Cena final: Wendy senta-se no chão derrotada e enojada enquanto Ronald está à distância rindo triunfantemente. Adicione a voz do locutor: "RONALD WINS." Texto dourado na tela: RONALD WINS. Congela a imagem, depois corta para preto.

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DA THREAD ---
[Thread 1] Tentamos fazer outro vídeo no estilo de jogo de luta de fast-food com o Seedance 2.0, desta vez: Wendy vs Ronald McDonald.

A ideia era fazer parecer uma paródia ridícula no estilo Street Fighter / Mortal Kombat, ambientada em um estacionamento suburbano entre um Wendy’s e um McDonald’s. HUD completo, barras de saúde, cronômetro, barras EX, movimento dramático de câmera, golpes em câmera lenta e momentos finais exagerados.

A sequência começa com Ronald avançando, mas Wendy contra-ataca derramando um milkshake de chocolate gigante no asfalto. Ronald escorrega em câmera lenta, é lançado por um chute giratório, e então de alguma forma volta com o ataque mais amaldiçoado possível alimentado por hambúrguer.

Eu queria que tudo parecesse uma luta de chefe de arcade falsa e caótica: órbitas cinematográficas de câmera, acelerações, asfalto molhado e brilhante, restaurantes de fast-food ao fundo, e violência de desenho animado exagerada misturada com energia de jogo de luta fotorrealista.

Feito com Seedance 2.0 usando um quadro de abertura e um prompt detalhado quadro a quadro.

Seedance 2.0 prompt:
"Use the uploaded image as the opening frame. Create a 15-second photorealistic fighting game parody scene in a suburban fast-food parking lot. Add a fighting game HUD with green health bars, character portraits, names, timer 60, ROUND 1, and EX bars.

Wendy stands on the left in a blue and white striped dress, white apron, red pigtails, striped stockings, and black boots. Ronald stands on the right in a red yellow white clown costume, red afro wig, white face paint, red nose, giant red shoes, and yellow gloves.

Bright afternoon sunlight, wet asphalt reflecting the sky, fast-food restaurants in the background, cinematic SF6 / Mortal Kombat style.

Start with the announcer saying “ROUND ONE — FIGHT!” Ronald charges forward at full speed. Wendy pulls out a giant chocolate milkshake and pours it onto the asphalt. Ronald slips on the shake in slow motion, arms flailing, shoes sliding across the glossy ground. Camera orbits him dramatically.

Wendy winds up and lands a spinning back kick while Ronald is slipping. Slow motion impact, speed ramp, Ronald launches backward across the parking lot and crashes onto the asphalt.

Ronald springs upright, pulls out a giant burger, eats it rapidly, then unleashes an exaggerated gross burp attack with a visible yellow-green wave and food chunks. Camera switches to Ronald POV as the stream flies across the parking lot and hits Wendy, launching her backward.

Final shot: Wendy sits on the ground defeated and disgusted while Ronald stands in the distance laughing triumphantly. Add announcer voice: “RONALD WINS.” Gold text on screen: RONALD WINS. Freeze frame, then cut to black."

Este ficou muito mais caótico do que o esperado, mas o Seedance lidou surpreendentemente bem com o movimento da câmera e o ritmo de jogo de luta.
---

使用上传的图像作为开场画面。在郊区快餐店停车场创建一个15秒的写实格斗游戏恶搞场景。添加一个格斗游戏HUD，带有绿色生命条、角色头像、名字、计时器60、ROUND 1和EX条。

Wendy站在左边，穿着蓝白条纹连衣裙、白色围裙、红色辫子、条纹长袜和黑色靴子。Ronald站在右边，穿着红黄白小丑服装、红色爆炸头假发、白色面具、红鼻子、巨大的红鞋和黄色手套。

明亮的下午阳光，湿润的沥青反射着天空，背景是快餐店，电影般的SF6 / Mortal Kombat风格。

以解说员说“ROUND ONE — FIGHT!”开始。Ronald全速向前冲。Wendy拿出一个巨大的巧克力奶昔倒在沥青上。Ronald在慢动作中滑倒，手臂挥舞，鞋子在光滑的地面上滑动。镜头戏剧性地环绕他。

Wendy蓄力并在Ronald滑倒时打出旋转后踢。慢动作冲击，速度加速，Ronald被抛向停车场并摔在沥青上。

Ronald迅速站起，拿出一个巨大的汉堡，快速吃掉，然后释放出一个夸张的恶心打嗝攻击，伴随着可见的黄绿色波浪和食物碎片。镜头切换到Ronald的视角，流体飞过停车场击中Wendy，将她击退。

最后一幕：Wendy坐在地上，失败且厌恶，而Ronald在远处得意地笑。添加解说员声音：“RONALD WINS。”屏幕上显示金色文字：RONALD WINS。定格，然后切换到黑屏。

--- 线程继续 ---
[线程1] 我们尝试用Seedance 2.0制作另一个快餐格斗游戏风格的视频，这次是：Wendy对Ronald McDonald。

这个想法是让它感觉像一个荒谬的街头霸王/真人快打风格的恶搞，设定在Wendy’s和McDonald’s之间的郊区停车场。完整的HUD、生命条、计时器、EX条、戏剧性的镜头运动、慢动作打击和夸张的终结时刻。

序列以Ronald冲锋开始，但Wendy通过将一个巨大的巧克力奶昔倒在沥青上进行反击。Ronald在慢动作中滑倒，被旋转后踢击飞，然后以最诡异的汉堡动力攻击反击。

我希望整个过程感觉像一个混乱的假街机BOSS战：电影般的镜头环绕、速度加速、光滑的湿沥青、背景中的快餐店，以及夸张的卡通暴力与写实格斗游戏能量的结合。

使用Seedance 2.0制作，使用一个开场画面和详细的逐镜提示。

Seedance 2.0提示：
"Use the uploaded image as the opening frame. Create a 15-second photorealistic fighting game parody scene in a suburban fast-food parking lot. Add a fighting game HUD with green health bars, character portraits, names, timer 60, ROUND 1, and EX bars.

Wendy stands on the left in a blue and white striped dress, white apron, red pigtails, striped stockings, and black boots. Ronald stands on the right in a red yellow white clown costume, red afro wig, white face paint, red nose, giant red shoes, and yellow gloves.

Bright afternoon sunlight, wet asphalt reflecting the sky, fast-food restaurants in the background, cinematic SF6 / Mortal Kombat style.

Start with the announcer saying “ROUND ONE — FIGHT!” Ronald charges forward at full speed. Wendy pulls out a giant chocolate milkshake and pours it onto the asphalt. Ronald slips on the shake in slow motion, arms flailing, shoes sliding across the glossy ground. Camera orbits him dramatically.

Wendy winds up and lands a spinning back kick while Ronald is slipping. Slow motion impact, speed ramp, Ronald launches backward across the parking lot and crashes onto the asphalt.

Ronald springs upright, pulls out a giant burger, eats it rapidly, then unleashes an exaggerated gross burp attack with a visible yellow-green wave and food chunks. Camera switches to Ronald POV as the stream flies across the parking lot and hits Wendy, launching her backward.

Final shot: Wendy sits on the ground defeated and disgusted while Ronald stands in the distance laughing triumphantly. Add announcer voice: “RONALD WINS.” Gold text on screen: RONALD WINS. Freeze frame, then cut to black."

这次比预期的更加混乱，但Seedance在镜头运动和格斗游戏节奏方面表现得出乎意料的好。
